description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number of the page to return in a paginated query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 账户名称是否支持模糊查询。要设置支持模糊查询时，请将该参数的取值设置为**1**，其他值或取值为空则表示不支持模糊查询。
description.en: Specifies whether fuzzy match is supported for account names. Set this parameter to **1** to enable fuzzy match. Any other value or an empty value indicates that fuzzy match is not supported.

description.zh:
要查询的账户是否拥有ROOT权限。取值包括：

- **0**：否
- **1**：是
description.en:
Specifies whether the account to query has ROOT permissions. Valid values:

- **0**: No.
- **1**: Yes.

description.zh: 账户上次登录检索的结束时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end timestamp for querying the last logon time of the account. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 账户上次登录检索的开始时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start timestamp for querying the last logon time of the account. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

> 第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken。
description.en:
The token that marks the current position from which to start reading. Leave this parameter empty to start from the beginning.

> Do not specify this parameter for the first call. The response includes the NextToken value for the second call. Each subsequent response contains the NextToken value for the next call.

description.zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的账户资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为**10**，表示每页显示10条账户资产的指纹信息。
description.en: The number of account asset fingerprint entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 account asset fingerprint entries per page.

description.zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址。
description.en: The name or IP address of the server to query.

description.zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

- **true**：使用NextToken方式。
- **false**：不使用NextToken方式。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve the vulnerability list data. If this parameter is used, TotalCount is no longer returned. Valid values:

- **true**: Uses the NextToken method.
- **false**: Does not use the NextToken method.

description.zh: 要查询的服务器的账户名称。
description.en: The account name on the server to query.
The UUID of the server to query.

title.zh: 查询服务器的账户资产的指纹信息
title.en: Query account asset fingerprint information of a server
